chapter_argument: Under one experimental source, one fixed Zhang--Li equilibrium network, one seven-branch time spectrum and one fair calibration protocol, compare the attainable joint time--frequency capability of progressively enriched traditional models and identify their bounded role as low-fidelity physical priors.

canonical_terms.T0: Equilibrium-anchored QLV with seven scalar memory modes
canonical_terms.T1: Seven-branch single-term Ogden model with shared flow parameters
canonical_terms.T2: Seven-branch single-term Ogden model with fast and slow flow parameter groups

T0.kinematics: equilibrium-stress hereditary QLV convolution with measured loading ramp
T0.nonequilibrium_energy: not represented by branchwise tensor internal variables
T0.flow_parameter_sharing: one nonnegative scalar Prony spectrum shared by all deformation modes and levels
T0.role: minimum transparent baseline and structural control

T1.kinematics: seven branchwise multiplicative decompositions F=Fe_alpha Fv_alpha
T1.nonequilibrium_energy: one-term incompressible Ogden energy with nonnegative normalized branch shares
T1.flow_parameter_sharing: one shared regularized hardening power-law parameter set across all seven branches
T1.increment_relative_to_previous: replace the scalar separable QLV kernel by objective tensor internal variables, Ogden nonequilibrium storage and state-dependent flow

T2.nonequilibrium_energy: identical one-term incompressible Ogden energy and branch spectrum parameterization as T1
T2.flow_parameter_sharing: fast branches tau<=1 s and slow branches tau>1 s use separate regularized hardening power-law parameter sets
T2.increment_relative_to_previous: only the declared fast--slow flow-parameter grouping is added relative to T1
T2.role: highest-complexity main traditional baseline and teacher candidate

T1-ZL.role: diagnose the same-shape Zhang--Li nonequilibrium-energy restriction; not a main chapter tier after the freeze

T2-ZL.role: diagnose whether flow grouping alone fixes the same-shape storage restriction; not a main chapter tier after the freeze

forbidden_silent_changes: changing branch count or fixed time scales
using amplitude DMA in calibration or representative selection
using separate parameter sets for plotted time- and frequency-domain predictions
renaming an old parameter file as a new teacher without recomputation
